title:
Transform for tabs in the App Configuration page title. This title is available in the Implementation page,
and this transform is mainly used to customize the tabs based on enabled features.

The provided JSON should contain the following parameters:
tabs {UiSdlPageTab[]} - Array of tabs to be displayed in the App Configuration page title.
hpoFeatureEnabled {Boolean} - Feature flag for Hyperparameter Optimization.
name: AppConfigurationPageTitleTabsTransform
